gtk4

gtk4 Components
  • Back A window's way back, while it can go back: a widget the runtime keeps hidden among the window's content, which has the window show a back button that presses it (rt's menu.c).
  • Canvas The drawing area a `draw.canvas` is.
  • Contents What a component renders several nodes, or a slot, at its top into: a box down the page.
  • Flow A flow is one GtkLabel, and the spans in it its Pango markup, which nests as they do: `<b><i>x</i></b>` is what `bold { italic { … } }` means, so Pango resolves the cascade.
  • GtkBox
  • GtkButton
  • GtkCalendar
  • GtkCheckButton
  • GtkDropDown
  • GtkEntry
  • GtkFrame
  • GtkImage
  • GtkLabel
  • GtkLinkButton
  • GtkPopover
  • GtkProgressBar
  • GtkScrolledWindow
  • GtkSeparator
  • GtkSpinner
  • GtkStack
  • GtkSwitch
  • GtkWidget
  • GtkWindow
  • Image An image is the runtime's box holding the source it shows, fitted as `fit` says, or the placeholder where it holds none (rt's image.c).
  • ImageDrawing A source showing what its shapes draw, `width` by `height` pixels: the shapes, as the calls that paint them, are the handler of its `@paint`, and a write to what they read paints the picture again, as a canvas is.
  • ImageUrl A source showing what a URL names.
  • MenuEntry One entry of a window's menu, and its submenu's entries: a box the runtime keeps hidden among the window's content, from which the window builds the GMenu behind its header bar's menu button (rt's menu.c).
  • Paint The primitive every shape below paints through: its handler is spliced into the drawing, written against the canvas's context.
  • Scroll A scroll is the runtime's GtkScrolledWindow, which moves along `direction` and reports the end of its content coming within half a viewport of showing -- as it arrives, and when the content changes size while it is there (rt's scroll.c).
  • Span
  • TabPage One tab: its panel, a page the notebook shows a tab titled `title` for.
  • Tabs A `ui.tabs`: the runtime's box of a GtkNotebook (rt's tabs.c).
  • Text A text is the runtime's GtkLabel, starting at the left of its box as html's does, and pressed through a click gesture, which a label has no signal for.
  • Toplevel A toplevel: the host object a `ui.window` is.
  • drawSource The primitive a `canvasImage` paints its source through.
  • platform The `gtk4` node of a build directive: `output { c { gtk4() } }`.
    • Types
  • CairoContext A canvas is a GtkDrawingArea whose drawing -- the shapes, as the calls the overrides below make -- is the handler of its `@paint`, handed cairo's context, which lowering connects as it connects any handler; a write to what the drawing reads asks for a paint through its redraw.
  • DrawEvent What a `@draw` handler is handed: the context, and the coordinate space the shapes were placed in.
  • GtkProgressBar
  • Look What a widget's style asks of the runtime (look.c): its CSS, its least size, its share of a box's spare room, and how a box lays out what it holds.
  • Picture The picture a URL names, decoded once: a file the program carries at once, one fetched when it arrives.
  • Schedule --- The timer --- A GLib timeout, armed as the effect mounts and removed as it unmounts.
  • SourceEvent What a `drawSource` paints a carried or fetched image with: the context, the URL its source names and the picture the source holds.
  • Widget Every node is a widget, held as its pointer.
  • ui
    • Functions
  • arcTo The corner `sngl:ui/draw` solves, drawn as a line in and an arc, which leaves the path at the point it answers: cairo takes a center and two angles where the command gives three points and a radius.
  • bordered Whether a Style says anything of its border, which then is all of it.
  • boxLookBesideVisible lookBesideVisible for a GtkBox.
  • boxLookOf The look of a GtkBox, which holds its spacing: its gap, or what the override spaces its children by.
  • calendarDate The day a calendar has selected.
  • checkActive What a control holds, read off its widget.
  • crossOf An unset alignment is CSS's default, stretch.
  • cssColor
  • cssOf
  • decl
  • dropDownLabel The label a drop-down has selected, or "" where it has none.
  • entryText
  • gridLookOf The look of a grid's GtkBox: a box's, laid out `columns` to a row, or flowing where it has none.
  • hover Puts w in the state a pointer resting on it puts it in, which its look draws: what a test snapshots to see a button shaded as it is hovered.
  • imageFailure Why an image's picture failed, or "".
  • innerFrameLookOf The look of the frame a clickable card's button holds: the button draws the card's border, so the frame draws the theme's only where the Style says nothing of one.
  • inset GTK takes no negative length, which CSS allows for a margin; an unset one is none.
  • justifyOf
  • length A length as CSS text, nothing where the Style leaves it unset.
  • lineOf A border its Style gives a width and no line is drawn solid, as every target without CSS's default of none draws one.
  • loadPicture
  • lookBesideVisible The look of a widget whose visibility a prop drives, which answers `display` itself through shown.
  • lookHidden
  • lookOf What GTK takes for a Style: CSS for the widget's own node, and beside it what GTK says through properties instead.
  • offerChoices Offers a drop-down the labels `labels` joins with newlines, and selects `chosen` where one of them is it and nothing where none is.
  • paint Fill then stroke the current path, keeping it between the two where both apply.
  • paintPicture Paints a picture into a box, scaled once per box size rather than per frame; one still on its way paints nothing, and is there the next time the drawing paints after it arrives.
  • press Puts w in the state a press holding it down puts it in, as hover does.
  • px A length in pixels, as codegen.MeasurementPx reads one for this target: an em is 16 of them, as html, android and bubbletea read one.
  • quit Ends the loop, and with it the application, which tears down before the entry returns: how a program whose windows are all hidden, or one an `@run` handler started without calling run, stops.
  • refPicture
  • selectDay Selects y-m-d on a calendar as a click on the day does, without reporting it.
  • selectLabel Selects the choice labeled `label`, as a pick does: unlike an offer, the drop-down notifies, so its @notifySelected handler runs.
  • setEntryText Writes an entry's text with its "changed" blocked, which an override does itself rather than binding `text`: see ui.input.
  • setLook Gives w its look: the `look` set of each class a `gir:Gtk-4.0` import declares, which is no package of the platform's.
  • shown
  • side One side of a margin or a padding: the first of its own field, its axis's and the whole box's that is set, as CSS reads them.
  • signalConnect Connects handler to w's signal, as the connect protocol does.
  • slantOf
  • source cairo wants each channel as 0..1 where SNGL carries 0..255.
  • spacingOf A box's spacing: its gap, or what the override spaces its children by.
  • switchActive
  • textAlignOf
  • unrefPicture
  • weightOf
  • wrapOf
    • Constants
  • unstyled What a Style may say that GTK does not answer: - maxWidth, maxHeight: GTK gives a widget at least its minimum and as much as its parent allocates, and nothing caps it.
